headline: Uber beats Waymo as first to launch robotaxis in London
summary: Uber launched London's first commercial robotaxi service, beating Waymo. The vehicles use autonomous tech from UK-based startup Wayve. Safety drivers will initially be present behind the wheel.

headline: Google says its new Gemini 3.8 Flash model ‘works harder’ but might cost more
summary: Google unveiled Gemini 3.8 Flash, a new AI model, weeks after its predecessor. The company claims it 'works harder' by performing more complex reasoning steps. It maintains the same introductory pricing as 3.7 Flash.

headline: Here are some of REI’s best Labor Day sale deals
summary: REI is holding a Labor Day sale offering discounts on outdoor gear. Deals include savings on men's and women's clothing, camping, and hiking equipment. It's an opportunity to prepare for upcoming outdoor expeditions.

headline: 1Password wades into a right-wing mess after funding a Linux project
summary: 1Password faced backlash for funding a Linux distro associated with controversial figure David Heinemeier Hansson. Hansson has previously published racist blog posts. The password manager is now a 'distinguished corporate patron' of Omacom.

headline: Save 26% Off Kirby Air Riders for the Nintendo Switch 2
summary: Get 26% off Kirby Air Riders for the Nintendo Switch 2. The game is described as a unique blend of Mario Kart and Super Smash Bros. This deal offers a significant saving on the popular title.

headline: The 2026 65" LG Evo C6 4K OLED TV Drops to $1,199.99 During the eBay Labor Day Sale
summary: The 65-inch LG Evo C6 4K OLED TV is available for $1,199.99. This significant price drop is part of eBay's Labor Day Sale. It's a great opportunity to acquire a premium 4K OLED television.

headline: Resident Evil's Zach Cregger Admits He Was 'Naive' to Assume Fans Would Approve of Him Avoiding a Direct Adaptation of the Games
summary: Zach Cregger admitted his naiveté regarding fan reception to his Resident Evil adaptation. He consciously chose to avoid a direct retelling of the game's story. Fans reacted unfavorably to his less-direct approach.

headline: Alienware Just Released the World's First 39" 5K Monitor With RGB Stripe Tandem OLED Technology
summary: Alienware has launched the world's first 39-inch 5K monitor. It features advanced RGB Stripe Tandem OLED Technology. This monitor is designed for both high-performance gaming and professional workstation productivity.

headline: Burnham pressed on economy at first PMQs as borrowing costs surge
summary: Burnham faced scrutiny on the economy during his inaugural Prime Minister's Questions. The Prime Minister affirmed his government's commitment to 'fiscal responsibility.' Questions arose amid a surge in government borrowing costs.

headline: King hails 'unprecedented' Bayeux Tapestry exhibition in London
summary: The King has praised an 'unprecedented' exhibition of the Bayeux Tapestry in London. British and French leaders will attend the display at the British Museum. The exhibition showcases the historic artifact.

headline: The overlooked factor driving the childhood obesity crisis
summary: A previously overlooked factor is significantly contributing to the childhood obesity crisis. Many children attending specialist obesity clinics are not in school. The article explores the link between school attendance and childhood obesity.

headline: Uber launches UK's first robotaxis with a driver - here's what it's like to ride in one
summary: Uber has introduced its first self-driving taxis in the UK. The initial fleet of 15 vehicles will operate with safety drivers onboard. The article offers an insight into the experience of riding in these new robotaxis.
